wetter.kopf.erklaerung: What is in the briefing, what is too much or too little for you and from when you get an alert.
wetter.kopf.fehler: The metrics could not be loaded. The connection to the server was lost. Your settings are saved and will not be lost.
wetter.vorlage.frage_route: Use ‘{neu}’? This replaces the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels of this trip.
wetter.vorlage.frage_vergleich: Use ‘{neu}’? This replaces the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels of this location briefing.
wetter.vorlage.verlust.one: Your 1 change from ‘{alt}’ will be lost.
wetter.vorlage.verlust.other: Your {count} changes from ‘{alt}’ will be lost.
wetter.vorlage.bleibt: Delivery, stages and locations stay unchanged.
wetter.alarm_ab.zaehler: {ausloesend} of {alarmfaehig} metrics trigger an alert. {ohne} cannot trigger one (precursors and display only).
wetter.alarm_ab.keine_alarmfaehig: None of the selected metrics can trigger an alert. Add, for example, wind, gusts or thunderstorms.
wetter.erklaer.normal_oben: Alert when the value rises above {oben} {einheit} since the last briefing ({stufe}), and on very large jumps. All clear when it goes back.
wetter.erklaer.normal_unten: Alert when the value falls below {unten} {einheit} since the last briefing ({stufe}), and on very large jumps. All clear when it goes back.
wetter.erklaer.normal_beidseitig: Alert when the value rises above {oben} {einheit} or falls below {unten} {einheit} since the last briefing ({stufe}), and on very large jumps. All clear when it goes back.
wetter.erklaer.gewitter: Alert when the thunderstorm level rises to {gewitter_stufe} since the last briefing ({stufe}). All clear when it falls again.
wetter.erklaer.gewitter_nie: With these colours thunderstorms never reach {stufe}, so no alert.
wetter.erklaer.nie: No alert. The colour only appears in the briefing.
wetter.erklaer.vorbote: Only coloured in the briefing. Precursors do not trigger alerts.
wetter.erklaer.anzeige: Display only: no traffic light and no alert. You set raw or simple below for each list.
wetter.erklaer.ohne_grenze: No limit is set for {stufe}, so no alert.
wetter.gewitter.fehler_farbe: This colour does not exist for thunderstorms.
wetter.gewitter.fehler_hoch_gelb: For thunderstorm level ‘high’ only orange or red is possible.
wetter.gewitter.fehler_hoch_schwaecher: ‘high’ must not have a weaker colour than ‘moderate’.
wetter.grenzen.hinweis: Green is everything between ‘yellow lower’ and ‘yellow upper’. An empty field means: no limit on this side.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_oben: Upper: yellow must be less than orange and orange less than red.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_unten: Lower: red must be less than orange and orange less than yellow.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_kreuz: The lower limit must not be above the upper limit.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_zahl: Please enter a number or leave the field empty.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_ungueltig: This setting is not valid and will not be saved.
wetter.nicht_im_briefing.hinzugefuegt: {metrik} is now in the briefing and appears in all lists under ‘Content per channel and view’. Set raw or simple there.
wetter.warnungen.beschreibung: in the briefing and as an alert as soon as they affect your area
wetter.radar.beschreibung: Alert when rain is coming towards {orte} within the next hour
wetter.anpassen.ueber_mitternacht: Crosses midnight and ends the next day.
wetter.dialog.name: Name
wetter.dialog.hinweis: Saved are the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels. Delivery, stages and locations are not included.
wetter.dialog.name_vergeben: A template ‘{name}’ already exists. Choose a different name.
wetter.dialog.gespeichert: Template ‘{name}’ saved. You find it under ‘Your own’.
